lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a discernible lattice structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance gradient on the superior edge and a low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin at the top-right frame edge shows a sparse distribution of approximately 4-6 high-luminance blobs, though visibility is reduced by motion blur and frame cropping.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower-center frame exhibits a distinctively higher spatial frequency of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
